limitations: One initial clone/install/build per instance type; command timings exclude wrapper scans and initial placement.
Native snapshot covers writable root filesystem and is tied to original image version; SDK DirectoryBackup and native snapshots used different trees and instance types.
Expiry is documented last-restore-plus-30-days, not an observed expiration.
Linux cgroup memory files were unavailable; cgroup CPU output is not used as billing attribution.
Build is the real compiler/services target, not the full upstream test suite. Node 24 npm did not authorize optional lifecycle scripts; no install-script setting was changed.

The original Node22 fetch client hit UND_ERR_HEADERS_TIMEOUT after five minutes on basic. The runner now uses node:https with an explicit deadline. A separate request retrieves the already-running build result without rerunning it.
